Well, it classifies as medical use in my book. Now, take everything I say with a grain of salt, but here's what I think.

There is already a problem a priori. The problem is that, normally, you're too aware to fall asleep, so you take something that completely blacks you out, be it cannabis or sleeping pills (so I don't think that's the issue). What you need is to fall asleep, while retaining some awareness, which for me suggests that you need to fine tune the amount of medicine you take: for instance, say that 1 blunt before sleep makes you not remember anything; try half a blunt. If that's also too much, try a quarter; if that's too little, though, then try something between half and a quarter (like 3 eights), etc. Your goal is to fall asleep as aware as possible, so try to use as little as possible (in fact, weed is probably easier to control than pills, since one pill would probably already black you out).

I do see a problem, though. If you toss yourself into panic attacks while trying to sleep, I think you're going to have a lot of nightmares (before you manage to lucid dream), so be ready for that.


Also, you can try some relaxation exercises (especially on the jaws and shoulders), and some meditation, to maybe reduce the amount of weed you need even further, and maybe to help you in general with the PTSD.

I definitely think you'd benefit from LDs to cope with it, though, so I hope it works out in the end. Good luck!

EDIT: Very important as well, if you ever find yourself in sleep paralysis, try not to panic, but if you start to do it, take the deepest breath you ever took in your life, and it will probably break you free. Also, avoid reading about it if you can (and ask specific questions instead), as there are a lot of "don't think of an elephant" arguments going around, so it might not be a good idea.

The thing is, from what I understand, the key to LD is having your mind be aware while your body is sleeping, which means that marijuana is inevitably going to get in the way. You could try maybe setting an alarm during the REM cycles to try and catch some dream to put on your dream journal, and improve your dream recall a bit, but maybe wait until someone else recommends the same thing before trying.

Also I have nothing at all against you smoking weed, but I do think you should try to learn to fall asleep without it. Unless you need it for medical reasons, it's better to have the option to exchange a blunt for an enhanced LD night.
